function.description: 抖音专用浏览读取：复用已连接Chrome，支持status/feed/search/read/open/next，以及resume恢复明确的长时间无操作暂停。固定浏览动作，无互动/发布，无Cookie或私有API。先读douyin_browse技能。视频语义仍须analyze_media确认。

function.name: analyze_media
function.description: 多模态图片/视频分析：解析实际画面、可见文字、节奏与剪辑；音频结论取决于真实音轨及模型输入能力。视频优先Files API上传并采样，不保证逐帧覆盖。三域抖音任务用video_url=current引用本任务刚观察的视频，无需复述长播放链接。凡对媒体内容下结论，必须有本工具成功回执；标题、点赞数和评论不能代替媒体证据。

video_url.description: 视频地址或三域抖音任务的current引用。三域研究须先douyin_browse观察，再传current；工具固定使用原始已观察播放源，拒绝猜测链接、旧网络记录和私有状态取流。普通任务支持真实流或详情页解析。超过512MB的本地视频可制作审查代理。partial/error/no_media_source不能当成理解成功；visual_track_only无音频证据，video_with_audio_track不等于独立逐字转写核实。

function.name: update_working_checkpoint
function.description:
Short-term working notepad, auto-injected each turn to prevent info loss in long tasks. Call during early/mid stages, not at end. When: (1) after reading SOP, store user needs & key constraints (skip for simple 1-2 step tasks); (2) before subtask switch or context flush; (3) after repeated failures, re-read SOP and must store new findings; (4) on new task, update content, clear old progress but keep valid constraints.

Don't call: simple tasks (1-2 steps), task completed (use long-term memory tool)

key_info.description: Replaces current notepad (<200 tokens). Incremental update: review existing, keep valid, add/remove/modify. Store: pitfalls, user requirements, key params/findings, file paths, progress, next steps. Don't store: ephemeral info, obvious context, old task info when user switched tasks. Prefer over-updating over losing key info

function.name: web_visual_click
function.description: [The tool that ACTUALLY clicks — use it when you want to 'click'] Use this when hardcoded selectors fail (page redesigned / element not found). Mechanism is Set-of-Marks: enumerate every interactive element in the current viewport and overlay red numeric badges -> screenshot, let the VLM answer a multiple-choice 'which number to click' -> precisely scrollIntoView that element and click it (does NOT rely on VLM coordinates, avoiding mis-clicks). If the target is off-screen, it auto-scrolls up/down to find it. After clicking it captures a page fingerprint to verify a real change happened (verified field). Note: web_learn_page only builds an index and never clicks; the only tools that actually perform actions are this one (and web_visual_fill for typing). Prereq: CDP bridge attached. [Smart] On hit, the resolved selector is auto-cached (.cache/web_locator_cache.json); subsequent calls with same URL + target_desc go fast path. [Typical uses] (1) any site where selectors can't be grabbed (2) operating unfamiliar sites (3) when web_execute_js returns not_found (4) when the target is far down a long page and needs scrolling. Write target_desc with position + appearance + text so the VLM picks correctly.

target_desc.description: Natural-language description of the target element. Include relative position + visual features + visible text. e.g. 'the red "Publish" button at top-right of the page' / 'the title input box with placeholder "Enter title"' / 'the "Save draft" button in the lower-middle area'

function.name: web_visual_fill
function.description: [Generic fallback] Visually locate an input -> physical click to focus -> CDP insertText to type. Same scenario as web_visual_click, for input fields when selectors fail. [Smart] After the first VLM call, the resolved selector is auto-cached; subsequent calls with the same URL + target_desc go fast path and skip VLM. [Typical uses] (1) any site's form/rich-text editor where selectors can't be grabbed (2) unfamiliar sites (3) React/tiptap/ProseMirror inputs.

target_desc.description: Natural-language description of the target input (position + appearance + placeholder)

text.description: Text to insert (via CDP insertText, friendly to React/tiptap/ProseMirror)

function.name: web_learn_page
function.description: [Indexing only — NEVER performs actions] It merely identifies the current page's interactive elements and writes them to cache. It does NOT click, type, or trigger anything. To actually click/type you MUST then call web_visual_click / web_visual_fill — a successful learn_page only means 'noted where the elements are', not 'did it'. [When to use] Rarely — only when you anticipate operating many elements on the same page and want to pre-build the index to save later VLM cost; otherwise don't use it, just call web_visual_click directly (which also auto-learns into cache on first use). The VLM identifies the main interactive elements in one shot and caches them (.cache/web_locator_cache.json). Prereq: current tab is already on the target page.

url_hint.description: [Optional] hint about the current URL; can be omitted (will auto-read location.href)

function.name: xhs_list_feeds

function.name: xhs_search_feeds
function.description: Search Xiaohongshu content by keyword (reads window.__INITIAL_STATE__.search.feeds, zero VLM). Returns a simplified note list, each with id + xsec_token + xsec_source for downstream tools. xsec_source here is 'pc_search' — you MUST pass it through to get_feed_detail/interact tools, otherwise the token/source mismatch triggers risk control (error_code 300031, '当前笔记暂时无法浏览'). Optional filters narrow results.

filters.description: [Optional] Search filters. Keys (all optional): sort_by(综合|最新|最多点赞|最多评论|最多收藏), note_type(不限|视频|图文), publish_time(不限|一天内|一周内|半年内), search_scope(不限|已看过|未看过|已关注), location(不限|同城|附近)

function.name: xhs_get_feed_detail
function.description: Read note detail and comments via CDP or desktop. Desktop opens an exact currently observed source link or reads the current matching detail, groups author/body/topics and loaded comments within the overlay, and reports unavailable media/state as null. load_comments does not claim exhaustive pagination.

xsec_source.description: [Optional but IMPORTANT] The token's origin page. Pass through the xsec_source returned alongside the token (search result → 'pc_search', home feed → 'pc_feed'). Mismatch triggers risk control. Defaults to 'pc_feed'.

xsec_source.description: [Optional] The token's origin page; pass through the xsec_source returned alongside the token. Defaults to 'pc_note'.

function.name: xhs_content_queue
function.description: 持久化内容队列：入队、列表、取消、执行到期项、仅重试提交前失败、读取作品核对中断项。running/uncertain 不自动重发。执行前读取 xhs_publish Skill。

owner_id.description: 测试队列必填，来自已绑定健康主页的稳定账号ID

expected_account.description: desktop 队列必填；执行时匹配创作中心页眉

run_after.description: 开始执行的 ISO 8601 时间，不等于平台 schedule_at

function.name: web_desktop
function.description: macOS 下使用现有 Chrome 的真实无障碍树、普通键鼠操作。浏览器桥缺失时可用。snapshot 返回当前 ref/snapshot_id；press/fill 必须使用同次观察的引用，动作后重新 snapshot 核对。先读取 perception_action Skill。

text.description: fill替换文本；type仅向实际聚焦的文本框逐字符输入

amount.description: scroll 的像素量，负值向下
